posts.title: 5 Tools For Hard Conversations
posts.description: After years of facilitating rooms full of disagreement, I’ve found a little structure goes a long way. I pulled five of my favorite suggestions together to help support you this upcoming season.

posts.title: Why Curious People Get Unstuck
posts.description: What I learned about curiosity, adaptability, and moving through the hard things. Curiosity. It might just be the antidote you need right now, especially if you’re spinning and stuck.

posts.title: Browse First: How Curiosity Unlocks Ideas You Can't Plan For
posts.description: Browsing takes intention. And intentional time set aside. It means holding a question open longer than is comfortable and looking down paths you haven’t been down before.
